tex_content.html:
Proposition
[$\pi _1$ of a connected graph is free] ↗ prop:maximal-tree-exists ↗ ex:wedge-sum-fundamental-group ↗ prop:quotient-by-contractible-hep-homotopy-equiv 1. ch1:1A.2\group Fundamental Group

If $T$ is a maximal tree in a connected graph $X$, then $\pi _1(X)$ is free with basis one loop for each edge of $X-T$.

Proof

\sketch Collapse $T$ to a point using the quotient homotopy equivalence. The quotient is a wedge of circles indexed by the edges outside $T$, so the wedge-sum calculation gives the stated free basis.

□
